facts.fact: GAMTEL says it is connected to the ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) cable through 4 separate international gateways, with 25,000 Megabit capacity from Portugal and France Telecoms; no landing station is named. The page is undated, so the date is its capture date.

GAMTEL states two international routes in service: the ACE cable, and a 28 Gbps backup link with Free (Senegal) on Cross Gambia (CG2) to which traffic is automatically rerouted if ACE fails; no landing station or border point is named. The page is undated, so the date is its capture date.
